name: El Barco de Ávila (Spain)
description: Square white flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Barco de Ávila (a boat on blue beneath a chief).
history: The flag is defined as a square flag, entirely white, with the municipal arms over the centre (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 178 of 14 September 1994).

features.role: El Barco de Ávila arms — boat on blue
